requirements.description: The user prefers properties near public transport (metro, bus, stations). Value set to the 75th percentile (70.93, rounded to 71) of the mobility distribution, since 'preferred near transport' expresses a proximity need. The building typology (school, at least 180 sqm, capacity for 14 people) is the subject of the search and is not a proximity requirement.

The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area. The capacity of 14 people is not a surface requirement and was not converted into an area filter. Proximity to public transport is a location preference and is not a column in this dataset. Turin is a city name, so comune_code was not set.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Attività scolastiche' AND surface_area >= 180 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND mobility >= 71 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters on the extracted requirements only: property_type 'Attività scolastiche', surface_area >= 180, a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892), and mobility >= 71. The capacity requirement (14 people) was not among the extracted requirements, so it is not applied. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinate.
